sections.name: Hero
sections.copy: AVERE STITCHES - Where Style Meets Craftsmanship. Experience bespoke fashion design that celebrates your unique style. From elegant traditional wear to contemporary statement pieces, we bring your fashion vision to life with precision and creativity. Based in Lagos, serving clients across Nigeria.

sections.name: About Us
sections.copy: AVERE STITCHES is a premier fashion and creative design house located in the heart of Alimosho, Lagos. We specialize in creating exceptional custom garments that blend contemporary style with timeless elegance. Our team of skilled designers and tailors are passionate about transforming fabrics into wearable art that reflects your personality and lifestyle. Whether you're looking for traditional Nigerian attire, corporate wear, or special occasion outfits, we deliver quality craftsmanship with attention to every detail. At AVERE STITCHES, your style story is our inspiration.
sections.imagePrompt: Photorealistic scene of Nigerian fashion designers at work in a bright, modern Lagos atelier, colorful fabrics and patterns displayed on walls, designers consulting with clients, measuring tapes and sketch books visible, professional yet warm creative environment, natural daylight, authentic Nigerian fashion workspace

sections.name: Our Services
sections.copy:
Custom Fashion Design - Bespoke clothing tailored to your exact measurements and style preferences, from concept to creation.

Traditional Wear - Exquisite native attire including Aso Ebi, Agbada, Kaftan, and traditional bridal wear that honors Nigerian heritage.

Contemporary Fashion - Modern statement pieces, corporate wear, and everyday fashion that keeps you stylish and confident.

Bridal & Special Occasions - Stunning wedding gowns, bridesmaid dresses, and outfits for all your special moments.

Alterations & Repairs - Expert fitting adjustments and garment repairs to ensure your wardrobe always looks its best.

Fashion Consultation - Personalized style advice to help you discover looks that enhance your natural beauty and lifestyle.
